integral_policy: Trapezoid over every original native point; exact phase boundaries linearly bracketed. Signed current positive into device; charge is total terminal exchange, not intrinsic channel/Cgd decomposition.

storage_observations.event_policy: Linear halfrail estimates include original native brackets; no waveform interpolation, extrema replacement or phase recentering.
storage_observations.hold_policy: Every original native point in400..900ps phase hold windows,10/90percent VDD bands; not library noise-margin or setup/hold signoff.
storage_observations.overlap_policy: Simultaneous source clock/reset assertion is deliberate; stable reset priority and any extra Q pulses are separate results, not automatically waived.
